evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.90 Torr at the start of growth, in line with the steady ~2.94 Torr seen during the ramp.
Pressure rose steadily and slightly faster over time, from 2.90 to 3.224 Torr in 600 s, at a constant setpoint.
Argon flow stayed steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by extra inflow from the flow controller.
Temperature is stable at 750 °C and heater power (~46%) is consistent, so the thermocouple looks fine.
No O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: Need a way to tell an air leak from a blocked exhaust: an exhaust O2 reading from a temporary sensor, a leak-up test with the valves closed, or a check of the exhaust line and pump conductance. Characterization of the sample is also pending.
